title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.even_add
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.even_add` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {m n : ℕ}, Even (m + n) ↔ (Even m ↔ Even n)
formal.kernel_statement: ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Iff (AxNat.Even (AxNat.add x0 x1)) (Iff (AxNat.Even x0) (AxNat.Even x1))))
